meta.source: Drafted from the AI Group Chat App pages in Notion (Purpose, Ai Collab Chat PRD, Technical Design Document) plus Eli's answers: name Huddle, calm & focused, ink + amber, Inter.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and chat-thread background.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Message bubbles from other people, composer, cards, menus.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar and session list; quiet wells. Text on it: ink or ink-muted only.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, bubble and card borders. Decorative, not a control border.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders (3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every paper and on amber-soft; fill for the primary button and your own message bubbles.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Names, timestamps, metadata and placeholders, on any paper or amber-soft (5.2:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ink fills (own bubbles, primary button).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The AI. Agent avatar, the agent's name, its thinking indicator, AI-only actions. As text only on paper or paper-raised (4.6:1 light).

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the agent's message bubbles and AI callouts.

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Amber-coloured text on amber-soft or paper-sunken (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text or glyph on an amber fill (the agent avatar).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rings, 2px, offset 2px. Kept apart from amber so focus never reads as 'AI'.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Delivered / connected status. As text on paper or paper-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed to send, disconnected, destructive actions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; gap between consecutive bubbles from the same sender.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Bubble vertical padding; gap between avatar and bubble.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Bubble horizontal padding; list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between message groups; card and composer padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Thread gutters; section spacing in panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins on desktop; empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, the composer.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Message bubbles (the corner nearest the avatar drops to radius-sm).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and presence dots.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers only. Bubbles and cards use line, not shadow.
